questions.why: Sinestro was born on Korugar, in space sector 1417.

questions.q: Which emotion powers the rings of the Sinestro Corps?
questions.why: The Sinestro Corps spreads a doctrine of fear and its yellow rings run on that emotion.

questions.q: Which actor played Sinestro in the 2011 live-action Green Lantern film?
questions.why: Mark Strong played Sinestro in 2011, the character's first live-action appearance.
John Broome and Gil Kane created the villain in Green Lantern vol. 2 #7.

questions.q: In which year did Sinestro debut in Green Lantern vol. 2 #7?
questions.why: He first appeared in Green Lantern #7, dated August 1961.

questions.q: What colour could Green Lantern rings not directly affect, a weakness Sinestro's ring exploits?
questions.why: Green Lantern rings were hindered by yellow, so the Weaponers of Qward gave Sinestro a yellow ring.

questions.q: Sinestro was whose instructor in the Green Lantern Corps before becoming his enemy?
questions.why: He trained Hal Jordan, then became his arch-enemy.

questions.q: Which alien group created the power ring for the banished Sinestro?
questions.why: The Weaponers of Qward built a ring in the one hue Green Lantern rings can't resist, to match Sinestro after his banishment.

questions.q: Which entity was revealed as the hidden 'impurity' in the Central Power Battery?
questions.why: Parallax embodies fear; it possessed Hal Jordan and later Sinestro became its host.

questions.q: Sinestro is said to have been born in which numbered space sector?
questions.why: Sinestro's home world lies inside that sector.
